title: Tox-BART: Leveraging Toxicity Attributes for Explanation Generation of Implicit Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to unmask and generate explicit stereotype explanations for implicitly racist posts, assessed via automated textual metrics (BLEU, ROUGE-L, BERTScore) and human evaluation of target group identification.
Assessing the model's capability to explain implicit religious stereotypes by comparing generated explanations against gold-label human annotations using semantic similarity and human ratings.
Evaluating generated explanations of implicit gender-based hate speech through automated metrics and human evaluation of generation specificity, coherency, and accurate target group detection.

Analyzing model outputs to determine accuracy in identifying and explicitly explaining implicitly homophobic or anti-lesbian stereotypes, utilizing both automated evaluations and manual error analysis.
